sections.h2: Who does what on a Rockdale County tax bill?
sections.html:
Three bodies shape a Rockdale bill. Appraisers under the Board of Assessors value the parcel, the Tax Commissioner collects, and the county commissioners, school board and city council choose the rates. The county's tax facts page adds that the commissioners control only the assessors' budget, and the Tax Commissioner is elected and answers to voters rather than to the assessors.

  • Assessors: 770-278-7676, P.O. Box 562, Conyers, GA 30012. Phone first to confirm where the counter is now.
  • Tax Commissioner: 770-278-7600, text line 678-964-4712, and an account portal at rockdaletaxoffice.org.

Real estate returns are filed with the assessors between January 1 and April 1. Anyone who thinks the value is too high may file one. It is mandatory after a lot split or after new construction in the prior year, and a late filing triggers a 10 percent non-return penalty.

sections.h2: What do Rockdale County's numbers show about local homes?
sections.html:
The county packs 98,416 people (July 2025 estimate) into 129.82 square miles of land, about 721 per square mile, and the estimate is 5.3 percent over the 2020 base of 93,487. The QuickFacts comparison records 34,437 households and 37,611 housing units, plus 339 building permits in 2025.

Two of every three households own, 69.6 percent. A typical owned home is valued at $292,900, a typical rent is $1,525, and the typical household earns $77,247. Residents born abroad are 10.7 percent, and 11.8 percent speak another language at home. Workers spend 33.7 minutes on the road each way.

Those values make a missed tax year costly. Before listing, ask the Tax Commissioner whether the parcel shows anything unpaid.

sections.h2: How is a Rockdale County bill worked out?
sections.html:
Market value is multiplied by 40 percent, exemptions are taken off, and the rate is applied to the remainder. Appraisers lean on three methods: comparable sales, replacement cost and income capitalization. The facts page points out that a bill can climb with an unchanged rate if value rises or an exemption is lost.

sections.h2: How do I file a value appeal in Rockdale County?
sections.html:
The quickest path is the assessors' real property page: search your parcel on qPublic, press the Appeal to Board of Assessors button and send the form. Georgia gives 45 days from the notice date, and the notice states the exact deadline.

Four grounds are open: value, taxability, uniformity and denial of an exemption. Complaints about the rate itself have no route here.

  • Gather recent sold prices and photos for comparable houses.
  • Name board or arbitration in the first filing.
  • Once the Board of Equalization or the court decides, the assessors need an on-site inspection before changing that value for two years.

sections.h2: What homestead rules apply in Rockdale County?
sections.html:
The final day is April 1, and the county says the law gives it no authority to extend. You need to have owned the house and lived in it on January 1.

The 2026 exemption chart lists the regular exemption at 15,000 off county maintenance and operations and 15,000 off school maintenance and operations, with a state component at 100 percent. Further lines serve age 62 and up, total permanent disability, and disabled veterans at 126,526, and variable exemptions apply where household income is $30,000 or less. A floating statewide exemption appears too. The HOST credit covers up to five acres and the main residence, while the state portion covers up to ten acres.

Take a current license, the recorded deed and a utility statement to the assessors. Income-based forms need the latest federal and state returns. One homestead per family unit is the limit.

sections.h2: When is Rockdale County property tax due?
sections.html:
The date is November 15. The Tax Commissioner's tax sale page says taxes still open after it become eligible for levy and sale.

Send payment in the pink return envelope, leave it in the drop box beside the front door, pay at the window or log into an online account. Cards cost 2.35 percent with a $1.00 minimum. The office refuses counter, third-party and payroll checks, and a returned check costs the greater of $35 or 6 percent.

sections.h2: How does a Rockdale County tax sale work?
sections.html:
Sales are public auctions at the J.P. Carr Community Center in Conyers, starting at 10 a.m. The office lists the next one for March 2027. Properties are advertised in the Rockdale Citizen for four weeks beforehand, and buyers pay by cash or certified check for a tax deed. Liens are not sold.

  • Bidding opens at the tax due plus penalties and costs.
  • The winner cannot move in, improve the land or evict anyone yet.
  • The owner or any party with an interest may redeem, and the buyer waits a year and a day before moving to cut off that right.
  • Money left after costs may be sent to superior court through an interpleader.

The Tax Commissioner's real estate resources page posts downloads of the sale list, excess funds and delinquent tax file. If you sell first, the overdue amount is paid at the closing table, so request a payoff before you accept an offer.

sections.h2: What does a buyer at a Rockdale County tax sale actually get?
sections.html:
Less than a normal purchaser. The tax deed is not a warranty deed, so the bidder carries the risk that the title has defects, and the sale is advertised as buyer beware with no guarantees. The winning bidder must pay within one hour, pays the clerk's recording fee, and takes on later taxes, including any owed to a city if the parcel lies inside one.

A mobile home passes with the land only if a certificate of permanent location was issued. A sale can be set aside for irregularities such as a bankruptcy filing or an assessment error, and the money is then refunded in full. Unbid parcels may be re-auctioned at 3 p.m. that day, or knocked off to the county.

For an owner, the practical point is the redemption window of at least twelve months. Redeeming means paying the deed holder what is owed, so the better move is to deal with the balance well before any auction date is set, whether by paying it or by selling.

sections.h2: Can I sell a Rockdale County house if tax is owed?
sections.html:
Yes. The closer pays the county from your proceeds and the buyer receives title free of that debt. A cash buyer removes the appraisal, lender repair demands and loan timing that slow an ordinary sale.

Heirs, landlords and owners who have fallen behind should get a payoff from the Tax Commissioner and a price opinion from an agent, and compare both with a cash offer.

faqs.q: What is the Rockdale County property tax deadline?
faqs.a: November 15, according to the Tax Commissioner. After that date unpaid taxes are open to levy and a tax sale.

faqs.q: What is the last day for Rockdale homestead applications?
faqs.a: April 1 of the tax year, with no grace period under the county's reading of the law. Call the assessors at 770-278-7676, and mail goes to P.O. Box 562, Conyers, GA 30012.

faqs.q: Who sets a Rockdale parcel's value?
faqs.a: The Board of Assessors, run day to day by its Chief Appraiser. County commissioners appoint the board and hold only the purse strings.

faqs.q: Does the Rockdale Tax Commissioner auction tax liens?
faqs.a: No. Only tax deeds are auctioned, and the original owner keeps a right to redeem.

faqs.q: What share of value does Rockdale County tax?
faqs.a: Forty percent of market value, as set by state law. Exemptions come off that figure before the rate is applied.
